Blinky 1.5.37

  • A pinned Codex ring stays on the same limit after a fallback to the app server. The app server names each limit the same way the web endpoint does, so a pin does not come loose when the read falls back. #102
  • A refused browser cookie store says why. When macOS will not open the store, Settings says to allow Blinky under Full Disk Access, instead of asking you to sign in again. #101
  • A ring can show CX ArtLab's robot. Under Settings → Providers, open an account's Appearance and turn on Robot in the ring: the ring draws that robot in place of the provider's mark and follows what the account is doing. The animated mark is gone.
  • Devin's usage card reads records routed through Oh My Pi. Records that name Devin appear in that card's history. #104
